tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: All product categories and series of the catalogue in one language, with name, URL and a one-line description.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Products of the catalogue in one language, optionally only those of one category. Each one with name, URL, short description and datasheet PDF.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side table of the specifications of 2 to 4 products (by URL, model or name), with the rows aligned by label, plus each one's description and datasheet.

tools.description: The interactive product selectors of amperis.com (circuit breaker analysers, battery chargers/dischargers, inspection cameras, electrical test instruments, transformer test equipment): what each one asks and the page where a person can use it. They only run inside amperis.com.
